changelog.title: What's New in 7.1.0
items: Auto-update: new versions download and install themselves from a banner - no more manual downloads
Refresh button in the top bar to re-sync your library anytime
New dashboard chart: your playtime for the last 30 days
Friend activity toasts when someone starts playing
Games launch silently - no Steam window flash anymore
Unified playtime: one accurate number everywhere, no double counting
2 new themes: Gruvbox Dark and Synthwave (8 total)

news.title: SteamLite 7.1.0 Available
news.content: Version 7.1.0 adds in-app auto-updating, a library refresh button, a 30-day playtime chart, friend activity toasts, silent game launching, and unified playtime tracking. This is the last version you need to download manually.

news.title: SteamLite 7.0.0 Available
news.content: Version 7.0.0 added the in-app Theme Shop, a multi-account profile switcher, a games-only library filter, and a new installer with install-location and desktop-icon options.
